snippet.title: Susanoo: Typing Soulslike - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Susanoo is a short experience soulslike-typing game where you type to attack enemies and press [Space] to parry incoming strikes with precise timing. Heavily inspired by Sekiro and Glyphica, made by one person. 

You play as Susanoo, a fallen god cursed for his arrogance, now seeking redemption by protecting every soul he meets before his curse consumes him. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4835750/Susanoo_Typing_Soulslike/

Developer: Vincent Dgoat
X: https://x.com/vincentdgoat
